passage.label: Indeed righteous among shades springs; fruits whatever desire; eat drink satisfaction used do; Indeed thus reward doers good; Woe Day deniers; O disbelievers eat enjoy little indeed criminals; Woe Day deniers; said Bow prayer not bow; Woe Day deniers; what statement after Quran believe

arabicExcerpts.text: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرۡكَعُواْ لَا يَرۡكَعُونَ

mainSubject.label: The righteous among shades and springs with whatever fruits they desire, told to eat and drink in satisfaction for their deeds since this is how doers of good are rewarded — woe that Day to the deniers; disbelievers told to eat and enjoy briefly since they are criminals — woe that Day to the deniers; those who refuse to bow when commanded to pray — woe that Day to the deniers; closing challenge asking in what statement after the Quran they will believe

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the first 'woe to the deniers' refrain after the Day-of-Judgement question (15) before the destruction-and-creation proofs block opens (16); P2 ends with the third 'woe' refrain after the earth-container argument (28) before the punishment-scene command begins (29); P3 runs through the smoke-shadow description, speech prohibition, assembly and planning challenge ending with the sixth 'woe' (40); P4 covers the righteous reward, criminal brief-enjoyment, prayer-refusal and closing Quran-challenge with remaining 'woe' refrains (41-50).
